text: Under which truth values of φ and ψ is the material conditional φ → ψ *false*?
choices: when φ is false and ψ is true
when both φ and ψ are false
whenever φ and ψ have different truth values
only when φ is true and ψ is false
explanation: φ → ψ is false in exactly one case: a true antecedent with a false consequent. When the antecedent is false the conditional is vacuously true, ruling out options 1 and 2. Option 3 describes when ↔ (not →) is false.
